title: Refactor Elements UI Clean Layout Abstraction
description: Redo: Refactor elements/ui to have a clean LayoutNode abstraction (Row, Column, Stack) so that golden-layout is only used internally. Every UI has Apps. Every App has WindowKinds and a default Layout. The LayoutNode replaces the raw golden-layout any configs.
summary: Reapplied the clean layout abstraction. Added LayoutNode/row/column/stack in elements/ui, changed UIWindowConfig.defaultLayout to LayoutNode, refactored createDefaultLayout/createTabStackLayout, and made UICanvas convert LayoutNode to golden-layout internally. Updated sketchpad AppWindowConfig, imports/exports, LayoutCanvas default-layout handling, and converted Kit app default layout to createDefaultLayout.
